author: felicepantaleo
body:
#### PR description:

A truth level is a full record of what it names, so `hardProcess` keeps the neutrinos of the hard scatter. No reco object can find a neutrino. A neutrino in the efficiency denominator therefore caps the efficiency below 1. On no-PU ttbar the `generalTracks` efficiency against `hardProcess` is 0.908, and the 11 neutrinos in the denominator cause all of the loss.

This PR keeps every level as it is, and `levelFlags` do not change. `TruthBranchTargetsProducer` now drops the invisible members from the level denominators `truthToRecoTargets<Level>` and from their eligibility masks. The candidate roots, `denominatorRoots` and `assignableRoots` do not change, so the association products do not change.

`PhysicsTools/TruthInfo/interface/TruthLevels.h` holds the species in one helper, `truth::isInvisible`: the neutrinos (12, 14, 16), the graviton (39), the PDG dark matter states (51, 52, 53), the lightest neutralino (1000022), the gravitino (1000039) and the Kaluza-Klein graviton (5100039). This is a subset of the CMS invisible lists in `GenSpecificAlgo.cc` and `genMetTrue_cff.py`. `truth::isInvisibleParticle` applies the list to a particle and keeps a member that the graph decays, for example a long-lived neutralino, because its decay products are visible. `truth::isNeutrino` is new. The reconstructable final state walk uses it, so the walk drops the neutrinos only, as before. `Branch::visibleP4` now excludes every invisible species.

The rule applies to every hit-based level denominator. On no-PU ttbar, `hardProcess` and `stableDecayProducts` hold neutrinos. `stableLegsFromInitialState` and `underlyingEvent` hold them when a preset builds these levels. The signal seed denominators do not change.

- `truth::isInvisibleParticle` is true when the species is invisible and every leaf below the particle is an invisible species. A copy chain of a neutrino is invisible. A neutralino that decays to visible particles is not.
- `truth::isInvisible` also holds the sneutrinos (1000012, 1000014, 1000016).
- `signalSeeds` drops invisible seeds, so a neutrino gun has an empty `signal` folder. `signalSeedsNoSelection` has no cut and keeps them. No sample in this PR books the signal folders, so this part is checked by reading only.
title: Drop invisible members from the truth level efficiency denominators
